name: Equal1
description: Equal1 develops silicon spin qubit processors fabricated using standard CMOS processes at foundries such as TSMC. The company's Bell-1 quantum server integrates qubits, cryogenic control electronics, and classical computing into a standard rack unit operating at 0.3 K. Equal1 was spun out of University College Dublin.
funding: $85M total; $60M Series B January 2026, €13.7M DTIF grant October 2025
